kept.name: nested_containers
kept.tip: Use indentation to create containers; keys must be unique within each scope.

kept.name: styling_shapes
kept.tip: Use shape: property with values like cylinder, person, cloud, etc.

kept.name: connection_labels
kept.tip: Labels on connections use the syntax: source -> target: "label"
kept.source:
A -> B: "request"
B -> A: "response"

kept.name: escaping_quotes
kept.tip: Escape quotes in labels with backslash, or wrap in single quotes.
kept.source:
"O'Brien" -> "It's done"

"She said \"hello\"" -> "Response"

kept.name: multiline_labels
kept.tip: Use newline character \n in labels for multi-line text.

kept.name: record-ports
kept.tip: Port names must match exactly; use A:f for field f of node A
kept.source: digraph { A [shape=record, label="{top|f|bot}"]; B [shape=record, label="{left|f|right}"]; A:f -> B:f; }

kept.name: html-labels
kept.tip: HTML-like labels require < > wrapping; escape special chars
kept.source:
digraph { A [label="Bold
New line"]; B [label="
Cell
"]; A -> B; }

kept.name: clusters
kept.tip: Subgraph names must start with cluster_ to form clusters
kept.source: digraph { subgraph cluster_0 { label="Group"; A; B; } C; A -> C; B -> C; }

kept.name: rank-same
kept.tip: rank=same forces nodes to same horizontal level
kept.source: digraph { { rank=same; A; B; } C; A -> C; B -> C; }

kept.name: edge-ports
kept.tip: Use :n :s :e :w :ne etc. for directional edge connections
kept.source: digraph { A [shape=box]; B [shape=box]; A:s -> B:n; }

kept.name: quoted-ids
kept.tip: Identifiers with spaces or special chars need quotes
kept.source: digraph { "Node A" -> "Node B"; "A B" [shape=ellipse]; }

kept.name: default-attrs
kept.tip: Set defaults at graph level for all nodes/edges
kept.source: digraph { node [shape=box, style=filled, color=lightblue]; edge [color=red]; A -> B -> C; }

kept.name: escape-chars
kept.tip: Escape { } | < > in record labels with backslash
kept.source: digraph { A [shape=record, label="{Header|Item1|Item2}"]; B [label="A < B > C"]; A -> B; }

kept.name: generics
kept.tip: Use angle brackets for generic type parameters on classes.

kept.name: stereotypes
kept.tip: Stereotypes must be attached to an element like a participant; a bare <<service>> tag is not valid PlantUML.

kept.name: visibility
kept.tip: Use +, -, #, ~ for public, private, protected, package.

kept.name: abstract-interface
kept.tip: Removed the invalid {abstract} and {interface} markers; PlantUML infers these from the class/interface keywords.

kept.name: packages
kept.tip: Use package blocks to group classes.

kept.name: notes
kept.tip: The colon annotation syntax is not valid in PlantUML class diagrams; use a Note block instead.

kept.name: escaping
kept.tip: Escape special characters with backslash in text.

kept.name: skinparam
kept.tip: Use skinparam to customize appearance.

kept.name: hide-empty-members
kept.tip: Use hide empty members to omit classes with no members.
